collection_metadata.locality: Pitchandikulam Forest, Auroville, Tamil Nadu, India

stem_bark.text: The bark of Reutealis trisperma is light brown-coloured and longitudinally fissured.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Reutealis trisperma is light brown-coloured and longitudinally fissured.

fruit.text: The fruit of Reutealis trisperma is a globose and 3-angular capsule . It is densely velvety-pubescent and 4-5 cm across.
fruit.text_html: The fruit of Reutealis trisperma is a globose and 3-angular capsule. It is densely velvety-pubescent and 4-5 cm across.

flower.text: The flowers of Reutealis trisperma are grouped in axillary and terminal racemes. The flowers are unisexual. The calyx-tube is cup-shaped, 2 or 3-lobed and about 5 mm long. The calyx is light green and finely pubescent. The corolla is composed of 5 pinkish-coloured and pubescent petals. The petals are elliptic, 1 cm long and 0.5 cm wide. The male flowers have 10 stamens in 2 series. The female flowers have bifid styles and 3-celled, globose and hairy ovary . The flowers are fragrant.
flower.text_html:
The flowers of Reutealis trisperma are grouped in axillary and terminal racemes.
The flowers are unisexual.
The calyx-tube is cup-shaped, 2 or 3-lobed and about 5 mm long. The calyx is light green and finely pubescent.
The corolla is composed of 5 pinkish-coloured and pubescent petals. The petals are elliptic, 1 cm long and 0.5 cm wide.
The male flowers have 10 stamens in 2 series.
The female flowers have bifid styles and 3-celled, globose and hairy ovary.
The flowers are fragrant.

leaf.text: The leaves of Reutealis trisperma grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, dark green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is chartaceous and glabrous on both sides (some minute hairs on the veins beneath). The leaves have a 6-12 cm long petiole . The blade of the leaf of Reutealis trisperma is 8-15 cm long and wide. The blade is heart-shaped, the apex is acuminate, the base is cordate and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaf is pinnate.

habit.text: Reutealis trisperma is a medium-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 15 m with a dense crown and a straight bole.
habit.text_html: Reutealis trisperma is a medium-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 15 m with a dense crown and a straight bole.

reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :
    Reutealis trisperma is monoecious, with unisexual (male or female) flowers on the same individual.
  • Mode of pollination :
    Reutealis trisperma is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.
  • Seed dispersal :
    Mechanical dispersal : barochory (dispersal of seeds by gravity), self-propagation.

phenology.text: ( This phenology applies to southeastern Indian plains )
phenology.text_html:
• Flowering season : From February to May.
  • Fruiting season : From August onwards.
  • Seeding season : From August onwards.
  • Leaves falling : During the hot season.

    • (This phenology applies to southeastern Indian plains)

reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :
    Reutealis trisperma can be planted in the sun or half shade. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining.
    The species is propagated by seeds.
  • Seed treatments :
    24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
